sql.where:
and lo.is_expired = 'Y'
and ( upper(p.product_name) like upper('%' || #{keyword} || '%') or upper(w.warehouse_name) like upper('%' || #{keyword} || '%') )
and upper(p.status) = upper(#{typeFilter})
and lo.warehouse_id = #{warehouseFilter}

mapper.select: select count (*) from lot_out lo join lot_in li on lo.lot_in_id = li.lot_in_id join inbound_detail id on li.inbound_detail_id = id.inbound_detail_id join product p on id.product_id = p.product_id join warehouse w on lo.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
